start_here: Say to your AI: "Which treg team does my connection pay from? I need the team number to read the balance." It runs tool:read-my-treg-team with {"account":"service_connection:treg"}.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it asks treg who your held token is and writes nothing.
instructions: 1. Connect treg once as service_connection:treg (or service_connection:treg:<account> for another team).
2. Say to your AI: "Which treg team does my connection pay from?". It calls tools:run with tool tool:read-my-treg-team and {"account": "service_connection:treg"}.
3. Read org_id in the answer: that is the team_id tool:read-my-treg-balance takes.
4. Nothing is spent and the token is never shown.

worked_examples.title: Find the team number for the balance
worked_examples.ask: Which treg team does my connection pay from?
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/treg/tool-rows.json: the row sends GET https://treg.to/auth/me with your token in X-Treg-Token and returns treg's reply unchanged. org_id is the field the row's output_schema and provenance name; the value 42 is a synthetic sample.
